Gerunds + Transport

love / like / don’t mind / hate + verb-ing

FAST MOVING WORD GAME

How do you usually travel?

Look, think and build the sentence before time runs out.

Grammar Reminder

SUBJECT + LOVE / LIKE / DON’T MIND / HATE + VERB-ING
I love taking the train.
She likes cycling.
We don’t mind using public transport.
He hates waiting for the bus.

How to Play

1. Watch the moving words.
2. Put them in the correct order.
3. Say the complete sentence.
4. Get 1 point + 1 bonus point before the timer ends.
